meta.method: Mapped path/footway/steps/track geometry near OSM peaks, filtered by proximity and terrain elevation. Summit connections use shortest connected paths from approach nodes; they are not designated hiking courses. Every section retains its own first and last point. The complete real-world trail inventory and current closures are not guaranteed.
meta.mountainGrouping: Nearby segments grouped geographically around each peak, with overlapping groups.
